【原视频简介】
What does a day in the life of a mom, teacher, and gardener actually look like? Today we're taking you along for the first day of school—from the morning rush and heading back to the classroom to coming home and taking care of a garden that definitely hasn't slowed down!

Summer may be winding down, but life in the garden is still incredibly busy. In this episode, we're giving you a behind-the-scenes look at what our everyday life is really like and how we balance family, teaching, gardening, harvesting, cooking, and everything in between.

The first day of school means a big change in our routine, but tomatoes still need picking, peppers keep ripening, weeds keep growing, and the garden doesn't particularly care how busy we are!

Come spend the day with us as we go from the classroom back to the garden and show you what it takes to fit gardening into an already busy life.

If you're trying to balance gardening with work, kids, family, or just everyday life, we hope this episode shows that you don't need unlimited time to grow your own food—you just have to make gardening part of your life.
